Patch Watcher's earlier run on Patrick Farrell's behalf: Patrick has taken over Shaun Tancheff's fix in change 66335 for now; Shaun can take it back. Rebased patchset 4: https://review.whamcloud.com/c/66335/4

Patchset 3's dirty-folio wait hung an OSS in CI. Patchset 4 instead writes out a dirty folio before IO, waits for writeback, and returns -EIO if it remains dirty after one writeout. The osd_write_commit assertion stays in place. lreview raised writeback-error handling, unbounded retries and missing error documentation; these were addressed. The -EAGAIN retry-sentinel suggestion was declined. The final two review rounds were clean.

On Rocky 10 with kernel 6.12.0-124.56.1, ldiskfs, one MDT and two OSTs, sanity-benchmark fsx, sanity-dom fsx and sanity 150id passed on master and with patchset 4. Neither reproduced the original !PageDirty LBUG in these local tests. Making 67323's fallocate flush conditional again caused data corruption in sanity 150id, not the original crash; adding patchset 4 made that test pass and logged nine dirty-folio writeouts.
